title: Great Wall Shinobi
tagline: Run the Great Wall at dusk and cut down every assassin who catches you.
blurb: Out through the Grand Gate and along the Wall as it rides the crest of the mountains, through watchtower after watchtower, over a valley drowned in mist, with the snow coming in and a huge low sun behind the range. Every lap another of the Kurokage clan joins the chase, then the lacquered guards of the Wall, faster and meaner than the last. Press X to swing your katana and cut them down before they touch you, dodge the barricades, braziers and supply carts, and every lap you finish pays the Emperor's bounty.
